input: Overreliance and unsafe use is a risk associated with A robotic system is designed to assist in monitoring and maintaining public health by taking body temperatures and providing surveillance in designated areas. It aims to support the identification and prevention of health risks, while also enhancing overall safety and security. The system operates autonomously, navigating through areas to gather data and provide real-time information.
